pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa āyasmato upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.4: bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa āyasmato upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.5: handa mayaṃ āvuso āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇāmāti. te ca bahū bhikkhū therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.7: etarahi kho āvuso bahū bhikkhū therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca āyasmato upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.8: sace ime vinaye pakataññuno bhavissanti amhe yathicchakaṃ ākaḍḍhissanti parikaḍḍhissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.10: athakho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.11: kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.12: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vinayaṃ vivaṇṇessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.14: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave vinayaṃ vivaṇṇethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.17: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā vinayaṃ vivaṇṇessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.18: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.19: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.20.1: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantīti sikkhāpadavivaṇṇanake pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.6: uddissante vā uddisāpente vā sajjhāyaṃ vā karonte.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.8: kiṃ panimehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi yāvadeva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.9: ye imaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tesaṃ kukkuccaṃ hoti vihesā hoti vilekhā hoti ye imaṃ na pariyāpuṇanti tesaṃ kukkuccaṃ na hoti vihesā na hoti vilekhā na hoti anuddiṭṭhaṃ idaṃ varaṃ anuggahitaṃ idaṃ varaṃ apariyāputaṃ idaṃ varaṃ adhāritaṃ idaṃ varaṃ vinayo vā antaradhāyatu ime vā bhikkhū apakataññuno hontūti upasampannassa vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.2: upasampanne vematiko vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.5: anupasampannassa vinayaṃ vā aññaṃ vā dhammaṃ vivaṇṇeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.3.2: na vivaṇṇetukāmo iṅgha tāva suttante vā gāthāyo vā abhidhammaṃ vā pariyāpuṇassu pacchā vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇissasīti bhaṇati
